### Library / Package Setup ###

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
school_indicator_data <- read.csv("school_indicator_data.csv")

tsi_groups <- read.csv("tsi_groups_data.csv")
```


### STAR Cleaning ###

```{r}
star_columns <- names(charter_df) %>%
  stringr::str_subset("Star Rating")

star_columns

charter_df[star_columns] <- lapply(charter_df[star_columns], as.numeric)
lea_public_df[star_columns] <- lapply(lea_public_df[star_columns], as.numeric)

charter_all_students <- charter_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Group == "All Students")

public_all_students <- lea_public_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(Group == "All Students")

charter_all_students <- charter_all_students %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(star_columns), ~ !is.na(.)))

public_all_students <- public_all_students %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(star_columns), ~ !is.na(.)))
```

### Average Star Comparison by Year ###

```{r}
charter_star_avg <- charter_all_students %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(star_columns), ~ mean(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Year", values_to = "Charter_Avg")

public_star_avg <- public_all_students %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(star_columns), ~ mean(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Year", values_to = "Public_Avg")

star_year_compare <- dplyr::left_join(charter_star_avg, public_star_avg, by = "Year")

star_year_compare
```

```{r}
trend_df <- data.frame(
  Year = c(2018, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025),
  Charter = sapply(star_columns, function(col) {
    mean(as.numeric(charter_all_students[[col]]))
  }),
  Public = sapply(star_columns, function(col) {
    mean(as.numeric(public_all_students[[col]]))
  })
)

ggplot(trend_df, aes(x = Year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Charter, linetype = "Charter")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Charter)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Public, linetype = "Public LEA")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Public)) +
  labs(
    title = "Average STAR Rating Trends",
    y = "Average STAR Rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Testing by Year (if there is a significant difference in testing by year) ###

```{r}
for (col in star_columns) {

  year <- stringr::str_extract(col, "\\d{4}")

  charter_values <- as.numeric(charter_all_students[[col]])
  public_values  <- as.numeric(public_all_students[[col]])

  test <- t.test(charter_values, public_values)

  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat("STAR Rating Year:", year, "\n")
  cat("=============================\n")

  print(test)
}
```

##### (LOW SAMPLE SIZE FOR CHARTER SCHOOLS / LIMIT TO LOW SCORE OUTLIERS) #####

```{r}
charter_all_students$School_Type <- "Charter"
public_all_students$School_Type  <- "Public LEA"

combined_df <- bind_rows(charter_all_students, public_all_students)

combined_long <- combined_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(star_columns),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Star"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = gsub(" Star Rating", "", Year),
    Star = as.numeric(Star)
  )

ggplot(combined_long, aes(x = School_Type, y = Star)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Year) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of STAR Ratings by School Type",
    y = "STAR Rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Comparing by district ###

```{r}
public_district_long <- data.frame()
for(col in star_columns) {
  temp <- aggregate(public_all_students[[col]] ~ District, data = public_all_students, 
                    FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  temp$Year <- col
  names(temp) <- c("District", "Rating", "Year")
  public_district_long <- rbind(public_district_long, temp)
}
public_district_long <- public_district_long[!is.na(public_district_long$Rating), ]

charter_district_long <- data.frame()
for(col in star_columns) {
  temp <- aggregate(charter_all_students[[col]] ~ District, 
                    data = charter_all_students, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  temp$Year <- col
  names(temp) <- c("District", "Rating", "Year")
  charter_district_long <- rbind(charter_district_long, temp)
}
charter_district_long <- charter_district_long[!is.na(charter_district_long$Rating), ]

public_districts <- unique(public_district_long$District)
charter_districts <- unique(charter_district_long$District)

par(mfrow = c(3, 4))
for(d in public_districts) {
  ratings <- public_district_long$Rating[public_district_long$District == d]
  hist(ratings, col = "#56B4E9", main = d, xlab = "STAR Rating", xlim = c(1, 4), breaks = 5)
}

par(mfrow = c(3, 4))
for(d in charter_districts) {
  ratings <- charter_district_long$Rating[charter_district_long$District == d]
  hist(ratings, col = "#E69F00", main = d, xlab = "STAR Rating", xlim = c(1, 4), breaks = 5)
}
```

### Heatmap of STAR scores by district for public and charter schools ###

```{r}
charter_df <- charter_df %>%
  mutate(School_Type = "Charter")

lea_public_df <- lea_public_df %>%
  mutate(School_Type = "Public/Traditional")

heatmap_df <- bind_rows(charter_df, lea_public_df) %>%
  filter(Group == "All Students")

heatmap_df <- heatmap_df %>%
  mutate(across(contains("Star Rating"), as.numeric))

heatmap_long <- heatmap_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("Star Rating"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "StarScore"
  )

district_summary <- heatmap_long %>%
  group_by(`District`, School_Type, Year) %>%
  summarize(
    Avg_Star = mean(StarScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  filter(district_summary, School_Type == "Charter"),
  aes(x = `District`, y = Year, fill = Avg_Star)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Charter Schools: Average Star Ratings by District",
    x = "District",
    y = "Year",
    fill = "Avg Star Rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 1),
  )

ggplot(
  filter(district_summary, School_Type == "Public/Traditional"),
  aes(x = `District`, y = Year, fill = Avg_Star)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Public Schools: Average Star Ratings by District",
    x = "District",
    y = "Year",
    fill = "Avg Star Rating"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold")
  )
```
